name: careTreatmentBase
description: Care & Treatment and ARV Management, sections 1.1-1.7 and PMTCT VL tracking: the active clients at the locations in the HIV monthly report dataset (etl.hiv_monthly_report_dataset_frozen) for the month ending on endDate -- one row per client -- who started ART this month or are on ART this month, as MOH 731 3.1 and 3.2 count them. Active means seen within 30 days of the appointment, so defaulters of 0-30 days are included. Each client carries an age band, sex, whether they count under MCH/PMTCT and a 1/0 flag per figure; the totals sum the flags and the linelist lists the clients with a 1, so the two always agree. WHO stage, CD4, breastfeeding and the refill date come from the client's row in etl.flat_hiv_summary_v15b at that encounter, and stability from its latest non-voided 12108 / 12127 obs (as MOH 731 3.5). The inflows and losses (1.5-1.7) compare with the client's row for the month before (p): last month's TX_CURR at this facility (its locations share a parent) who are not on ART now are TX_ML, by their status now; clients back on ART after being a defaulter or LTFU are TX_RTT; and those on ART here now, not last month, who are neither new nor back, transferred in. Losses are kept in the population too, so it is the clients on ART this month or last.
